title: Sunspot Watch
text:
☀️ Sunspot Watch — November 08, 2026

NOAA Active Region 4566 stands out on the visible solar disk today as a sunspot region associated with recent M-class activity.

📍 Location: S06W07
☀️ Region: AR 4566
🔥 Recent activity: 1 M-class flare · 8 C-class flares

A little extra texture today. ☀️

Sunspots are cooler, magnetically active regions of the solar surface and are often associated with solar flares and other activity.

Images: NASA SDO/HMI — Continuum Intensity, Intensitygram (Flattened), Intensitygram
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center + NASA SDO
